bng.text: Aesrias, a famous Akroan hero of Iroas, brings harpy heads to Governor Pilun in Tynthal, but Pilun accuses him of stealing from a merchant on a stranger's false testimony and has the guards seize him.

Tired and suspecting a plot, he lets himself be shackled, and in the coliseum's holding pen he realizes he is meant for illegal arena killing, where a star-skinned nyxborn who knew his mother blesses him with Iroas's power.

Deafened to their songs by wax, he kills several of the nine chained sirens with their own chains, and the remaining four carry him out of the coliseum into the countryside, where he kills them when they tire.
With the blessing fading, he resolves to inform the king of Pilun's secession.
